sentences.text: Abandon the boat only when it’s clearly lost, because even a swamped boat is easier for rescuers to find than people in the water.
Before leaving, send a Mayday by voice and DSC, and activate the EPIRB.
Make sure everyone has a life jacket on, and grab a ditch bag with a handheld radio, personal locator beacon, flares, water and medications.
The old saying is to step up into a life raft, meaning leave only when the boat is sinking out from under you.
Stay together, and stay near the boat’s last known position, where searchers will start looking.
